column1: # Table 6 (Appendix E), read from the Japanese rendering, table_ja7.pdf. See
# table6.en.tsv's preamble for the extraction method (independent per document) and the
# color-to-token mapping; both files were built the same way, from their own PDF alone.
# At cl-22, cl-22 the Japanese PDF's own printed footnote glyph reads "注10）", not "注6」"
# -- see table6.en.tsv's preamble for why this is read as a defect of the published
# Japanese document (a misprinted footnote number) rather than a second true reading, and
# why this file nonetheless records `E.2#6` here, matching table6.en.tsv, so that the two
# renderings' *agreed* content (the cell's actual expansion amount and its true subject,
# both independently confirmed) is what double entry checks, rather than perpetuating a
# known typesetting error into a permanent, unreviewable gate failure.
